mapper.insert: insert into team_user ( team_id, user_id, team_role, withdrawn, joined_at ) values ( #{teamId}, #{userId}, #{teamRole}, 0, NOW() )
mapper.select: select u.*, tu.team_role from team_user tu JOIN user u ON u.user_id = tu.user_id where team_id = #{teamId} and COALESCE(withdrawn_at, false) = false
select team_role from team_user where team_id = #{teamId} and user_id = #{userId} and COALESCE(withdrawn, 0) = 0
